frozenOriginalFit.source: Original stored fully activated calibration coordinates; authored fibers and sheets retained unchanged
frozenOriginalFit.reason: Frozen diagnostic only; 256-point projected/full nodal equilibrium fail

limits: Full nodal forces are a separate diagnostic: passing projected force balance does not pass full nodal stationarity.

Virtual displacement is dimensionless phi=(1-s)*reference axis, so derivative with respect to a metre of virtual displacement is a force in N. It equals the axis on the distal cap and zero on the proximal cap.
Direct body/sheet cap forces, external support forces, and whole-body virtual work are reported separately; virtual-minus-direct contains unbalanced free-node work at a restricted equilibrium.
Active Cauchy scalar is a*sigma0*fL*lambda/J along the current local fiber; it is not the peak first-Piola parameter.
No optimizer, refit, state advancement or derivative model change.
Original 32-point calibration force is a generalized boundary force; direct nodal end force and whole-body virtual work need not agree at a failed full-nodal pose.
Hessian is only in the original restricted free-coordinate space; its spectrum cannot establish full nodal stability.
